name: Gleiphnir Codespaces
postCreateCommand: bash -c 'sed -i "s|~/.local/bin/mise|mise|g" ~/.bashrc || true; if grep -q "mise activate bash" ~/.bashrc; then sed -i "s|.*mise activate bash.*|command -v mise >/dev/null 2>\&1 \&\& eval \"\$(mise activate bash)\"|" ~/.bashrc; else echo "command -v mise >/dev/null 2>&1 && eval \"\$(mise activate bash)\"" >> ~/.bashrc; fi'
